protocol.reference_method: exact canonical interval-mask multiset sum with permutation multiplicity; directly validated one-slot GP likelihood lookup; count, rate and eleven analytic base-normalizer checks; both references before any sampler
protocol.rate_selection: per observation maximize min(exact P(A), P(B)); tie to lower rate
protocol.difficulty_validation: both observations: selected exact A/B >=0.10 and beta=0.5 B <= half beta=1 B; if either fails, stop all sampler inference
protocol.joint_cells: 33 alive totals by 3 frame-six clutter counts by (last-frame detections + 1) last-frame clutter counts: 198 eight-case and 297 nine-case cells
protocol.comparison: per-run 3D joint TV, maximum mode and cell errors versus 1000 exact IID multinomial q95 per case and particle count; also 2D collapsed joint, alive and two clutter means; six-run mean signed 3D cells versus familywise q95 from 1000 exact groups of six
protocol.persistence_rule: at 2048 particles: persistent_mode_tail and persistent_joint_tail require >=2/6 q95 exceedances in both cases; shared_cell_shift requires the same 3D cell to exceed each familywise six-run mean q95 with the same sign in both cases; nested cases are not independent
protocol.run_order: eight reference then nine reference; eight 512/2048 seeds 1160..1165; nine 512/2048 seeds 1170..1175
protocol.interpretation: nested designed eight/nine-detection bridge; descriptive IID references, not independent population replication or WP11k 19-detection calibration; no move selection, 8192 or untouched holdout
